summary: Iteration 12: Tested Points/Gamification System, Push Notifications, and Chat Stickers. All 15 backend tests passed. Fixed bug in MessageAttachment model where 'url' field was required, causing sticker messages to fail (500 error).

fixed_in_this_iteration.issue: Sending sticker messages failed with 500 error - MessageAttachment model required 'url' field but emoji stickers have no URL
fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Made 'url' field optional in MessageAttachment model, added sticker-specific fields (sticker_id, emoji, is_emoji)

integration_issues.issue: When navigating to /chat from dashboard, sometimes redirects to login - appears to be intermittent auth state issue in Playwright tests
integration_issues.note: This seems to be a test environment issue. The actual frontend code and auth context look correct.

critical_code_review_comments: Points API correctly implements levels, streaks, and daily check-in with idempotent behavior
Leaderboard enriches user data with profile info and calculates user's own rank
Notification subscription stores browser push subscription and manages preferences
StickerPicker component (line 80-212) has good UX with pack tabs, search, and recent stickers
StickerMessage component (line 215-235) correctly renders both emoji and image stickers
ChatPage integrates sticker picker via handleSendSticker (line 578-607)

success_rate.frontend: Verified via API - sticker messages working

seed_data_creation: Sent test sticker messages to existing chat 52772b5a-e01c-454f-abf3-ce4b51fc1866
context_for_next_testing_agent: Points and Notifications APIs fully tested. Sticker message bug fixed. Chat UI testing was limited by Playwright auth state issues but sticker API is verified working via curl tests.

points_api_get_me.details: Returns total_points, level (with badge/name), next_level, points_to_next_level, streak_days, recent_earnings

points_daily_check_in.details: Awards 5 points daily, tracks streak, bonus at 7/30 days, idempotent (no double points)

points_leaderboard.details: Returns ranked users with points, level, streak; includes current user's rank

points_history.details: Returns transaction history with action, points, description, timestamp

notifications_subscribe.details: Stores browser push subscription (endpoint, keys) - MOCKED actual push sending

notifications_status.details: Returns subscribed boolean and updated_at timestamp

notifications_preferences.details: Manages notification types: calls, messages, likes, comments, followers, promotions

sticker_messages.details: Both emoji stickers (no URL) and custom stickers (with URL) now work correctly

sticker_picker_component.details: Has 4 sticker packs (BRUNO, Emojis HD, Reacciones, Negocios), search, recent stickers

sticker_message_rendering.details: Renders sticker messages with emoji or image based on is_emoji flag

test_categories: Points System (7 tests): get_my_points, requires_auth, daily_check_in, idempotent, leaderboard, limit, history
Notifications (8 tests): status, subscribe, status_after_subscribe, preferences_get, preferences_update, unsubscribe, recent, requires_auth

web_push.details: Backend stores subscriptions but doesn't send actual push notifications (needs pywebpush)

custom_stickers.details: BRUNO sticker images at /stickers/*.png not uploaded, fallback to emoji display

bug_fix_details.root_cause: MessageAttachment model had 'url: str' as required field, but emoji stickers don't have URLs
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Changed to 'url: Optional[str] = None' and added sticker fields: sticker_id, emoji, is_emoji
bug_fix_details.verification: Tested via curl - both emoji stickers and custom stickers now work correctly
